verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say users can create agents by describing a workflow, automate status updates and reports on a set schedule, and trigger automations from integrations, with workloads running on monday-managed infrastructure. Together these show background automation that the product itself provides. The evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the automation builder (triggers, conditions, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents and automations run reliably without supervision.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
